```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(fixest)
library(patchwork)
library(stargazer)
library(nlme)
library(plm)
```



```{r reading}

pitching <- read.csv("pitching_2015_2024.csv")


#selecting only pitchers with more than 50 IP because they are most likely starters and will have the most consistent data
pitching_selected <- pitching[ pitching$IP > 50, c("WHIP", "ERA", "HR.9", "Age", "K.9", "Team", "Season")]



```



```{r}
model1 <- feols(ERA ~ WHIP | Season, data = pitching_selected)
summary(model1)
model2 <- feols(ERA ~ WHIP + HR.9 | Season, data = pitching_selected)
summary(model2)
```

```{r}
p_ols <- plm(ERA ~ WHIP + HR.9, data = pitching_selected, model = "pooling", index = "Season")
p_fe  <- plm(ERA ~ WHIP + HR.9, data = pitching_selected, model = "within", index = "Season")

phtest(p_fe, p_ols)

```
